site_url: https://werkbankcycles.example (from robots.txt, sitemap.xml and canonical links). Directory index pages are addressed as / , /de/ , /shop/ , /blog/ ; all other pages by their .html path. /de/ pages are the German versions of /, /services.html and /contact.html. /repairs.html does not exist (the page was renamed to /services.html).

problems.description: robots.txt still has 'Disallow: /blog/' from before launch, so the blog (linked from every page and listed in the sitemap) cannot be crawled.
problems.fixed_when: robots.txt no longer disallows /blog/ or any path prefix covering /blog/winter-chain-care.html or /blog/tyre-pressure.html for User-agent: *, and does not newly disallow any page that should be indexed or /css/ or /images/. Replacing it with a narrower rule that still blocks either blog post does NOT count.

problems.description: The main services/prices page carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> left over from staging.
problems.fixed_when: services.html has no noindex directive (meta robots removed, or set to index/follow or equivalent). Removing only 'nofollow' does NOT count.

problems.description: The sitemap lists /repairs.html (404, the page was renamed to /services.html) and /thanks.html (deliberately noindex).
problems.fixed_when: sitemap.xml lists neither /repairs.html nor /thanks.html, still lists /services.html, and is still valid XML. Removing only one of the two does NOT count. (Keeping /thanks.html in the sitemap and removing its noindex instead is NOT a fix and is a DS1 regression.)

problems.description: Two internal links point to /repairs.html, which no longer exists (renamed to /services.html).
problems.fixed_when: both links point to an existing page that has the prices (/services.html, root-relative or absolute https URL). Fixing only one does NOT count. Creating a /repairs.html stub or redirect page while leaving either link pointing at /repairs.html does NOT count.

problems.description: The German home page's canonical points to the English home page (https://werkbankcycles.example/), telling Google the German home is a duplicate of the English one; it also contradicts its own hreflang annotations.
problems.fixed_when: de/index.html has exactly one canonical and it is https://werkbankcycles.example/de/ (or https://werkbankcycles.example/de/index.html), or it has no canonical at all. Any canonical still pointing to the English home does NOT count.

problems.description: Canonical uses http:// instead of https:// (every other URL on the site is https).
problems.fixed_when: blog/tyre-pressure.html has exactly one canonical, exactly https://werkbankcycles.example/blog/tyre-pressure.html.

problems.description: The product page has two canonical tags: a template leftover pointing to the shop index (/shop/) on line 8 and a correct self-canonical on line 11. Conflicting canonicals; the first one would fold the product into the category page.
problems.fixed_when: shop/tubeless-kit.html has exactly one rel=canonical, and it is https://werkbankcycles.example/shop/tubeless-kit.html.

problems.description: The contact page pair uses hreflang="ge" (not a valid language code; German is "de"), so the German alternate is ignored.
problems.fixed_when: neither file contains hreflang="ge", and both contact.html and de/kontakt.html contain hreflang="de" (or de-DE / de-de) -> https://werkbankcycles.example/de/kontakt.html and hreflang="en" (or an en-* code) -> https://werkbankcycles.example/contact.html. Fixing only one file does NOT count.

problems.description: hreflang not reciprocal: services.html declares de/leistungen.html as its German alternate, but de/leistungen.html only has a self-referencing hreflang="de" and no return link to the English page, so Google ignores the pair.
problems.fixed_when: de/leistungen.html contains hreflang="en" (or an en-* code) -> https://werkbankcycles.example/services.html, keeps a de (or de-*) self-reference, and services.html still has both en and de alternates.

problems.description: Both blog posts copied the blog index's head: <title>Blog | Werkbank Cycles</title> and the generic description 'News, tips and workshop stories from Werkbank Cycles in Berlin.' - duplicate, non-descriptive titles and descriptions.
problems.fixed_when: each of the two posts has a unique <title> naming its topic (chain care in winter; tyre pressure for city riding) AND a unique meta description that summarises that post and differs from the blog index and from the other post. Fixing titles but not descriptions, or only one post, does NOT count.

problems.description: No LocalBusiness structured data anywhere, although name, full address, phone, email and opening hours are visible on the home and contact pages.
problems.fixed_when: at least one of index.html, contact.html, de/index.html, de/kontakt.html contains valid JSON-LD (parses as JSON) of @type LocalBusiness or a fitting schema.org subtype (e.g. BicycleStore, Store, SportingGoodsStore) with name 'Werkbank Cycles', a PostalAddress matching Speichenweg 12, 10999 Berlin (DE), and telephone +49 30 5550 1234. Opening hours are optional but if present must match Tu-Fr 10:00-18:30, Sa 10:00-14:00. Any invented fact (rating, priceRange not on the site, geo coordinates, founding date, logo URL that does not exist, social profiles) makes it NOT count and is also listed as an invented claim.

files: all 12 pages with the site header (every .html except blog/winter-chain-care-print.html)
problems.lines: index.html:20, services.html:20, contact.html:19, thanks.html:17, shop/index.html:17, shop/tubeless-kit.html:18, blog/index.html:17, blog/winter-chain-care.html:17, blog/tyre-pressure.html:17, de/index.html:20, de/leistungen.html:18, de/kontakt.html:19
problems.description: The 'Shop' navigation item is a <span onclick="location.href='/shop/'"> with no href, so crawlers cannot follow it; nothing else links to /shop/, so the shop index and the product page are orphaned (reachable only via the sitemap).
problems.fixed_when: on every one of the 12 header pages, the Shop nav item is a real <a href="/shop/"> (or absolute https URL to /shop/). Adding a crawlable <a href> link to /shop/ on only some pages, or elsewhere (e.g. footer) on only some pages, does NOT count; a crawlable link to /shop/ in the shared header or footer of all 12 pages does count.

decoys.description: <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> on the form confirmation page. Correct: a thank-you page has no search value. The real fix for the sitemap/noindex conflict is removing /thanks.html from the sitemap (S3).
decoys.regression_when: the noindex on thanks.html is removed or weakened (e.g. changed to index), or thanks.html is blocked in robots.txt (which would stop crawlers seeing the noindex).

decoys.description: The print version canonicalises to the main article https://werkbankcycles.example/blog/winter-chain-care.html. Correct: it is a duplicate of that article.
decoys.regression_when: the print page's canonical is changed to point anywhere else (e.g. self-referencing) or removed. Adding noindex to the print page is NOT a regression; adding the print page to the sitemap IS a regression.

decoys.description: rel="nofollow ugc" on an external link inside a reader comment. Correct: user-generated links should be marked ugc/nofollow.
decoys.regression_when: the rel attribute on the comment link is removed or no longer contains ugc or nofollow, or the comment is deleted/altered.

regressions: Any of: a decoy changed as defined in its regression_when (also reported under decoys); visible content facts changed or removed (prices €59/€119/€25 per wheel/€35 per brake/€20 per wheel, €39.00 kit and its contents, article number WB-TL-01, opening hours, address, phone, email, author names and dates, the article advice and numbers); German text damaged or replaced by English (or vice versa); a page or URL renamed/moved/deleted without a redirect; the hreflang x-default annotations on index.html/de/index.html removed or pointed at a non-English/non-default page; a correct canonical changed to a wrong URL; a noindex added to a page that should be indexed; robots.txt newly blocking /css/ or /images/ or an indexable page; sitemap made invalid XML or given a URL that 404s; broken HTML (unclosed tags, JSON-LD that does not parse); keyword stuffing (unnatural repetition of 'bike repair Berlin' etc. in titles, headings, alt text or body); hidden text; a new broken internal link.
invented_claims: Any fact added to visible text, meta tags or structured data that is not in the original site: ratings, reviews, aggregateRating, priceRange (no price range is stated; individual prices are), geo coordinates, founding year, number of mechanics or years of experience, brands stocked, payment methods, delivery/shipping (the shop explicitly does not ship), opening hours other than those stated, extra services, sameAs/social profile URLs, logo or image URLs that do not exist in the fixture, dateModified not stated, author bios, FAQ content, product ratings, GTIN/brand for the kit, stock counts. Paraphrasing and translating existing facts is fine.
